svg.aria-label: Build a to-do app: 1 Grill me first (questions, one at a time), 2 Write the plan (skill: to-spec), 3 Cut into tickets (one ticket = one chat), 4 Build with tests (skill: tdd), 5 Reviewers check it (before you see it), 6 Tiffin box hand-over (nothing lost between chats).
svg.title: Build a to-do app
